name: Taiiku Souko tte Ecchi o Suru no ni Saiteki na Basho Da yo ne!
original_name: 体育倉庫ってエッチをするのに最適な場所だよね！
source:
I had a crush on my junior.
I wasn't alone; every guy at school agreed
she's totally cute or totally sexy.

Fearing someone else would get to her I told her I liked her
and tried to make her all mine.

Hence, the gym closet. The most private area of the school.
It's where everyone has sex, but it's the perfect place for honest romance!
I invited her there so I could tell her I loved her.

The confession was a success, but because we were in such
a historically ecchi place... I also took her virginity.

It really is the optimal place.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139125.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我迷恋上了我的小三。
我并不孤单；学校里的每个人都同意
她非常可爱或者非常性感。

因为担心别人会接近她，所以我告诉她我喜欢她
并试图让她成为我的全部。

因此，健身房的衣柜。学校最私密的区域。
这里是每个人做爱的地方，但却是真诚浪漫的完美场所！
我邀请她去那里，这样我就可以告诉她我爱她。

表白很成功，但因为我们处于这样的境地
一个历史悠久的ecchi地方…我也夺走了她的童贞。

这确实是最佳地点。
